title: 第13章 考校第14章 玄阴剑诀
content_zh:
;;
苏白尘找到了那处校场，的确是难得的开阔好去处。
面向大海，视野无比开阔，与他那在海峡中的袇房比起来不可同日而语。
只可惜长老们的袇房也在此处，他如果在这里练剑，必然会惊扰这校场平台附近袇房中的长老们。
虽然枫林子说没关系，但他可不是那种会找麻烦的性格。
所以在仔细扫视了一下四周之后，干脆就走到了那楼梯通道中！
这个巨大的楼梯井就叫做‘通天梯’，四周固然是盘旋向上的楼梯，可中间还是个巨大的空井啊。
苏白尘在这和一个小广场似的空井底部，随手捡了根树枝，然后舒展地演练起了‘长春养真剑’。
他越是练习这门剑法，其实越觉得它博大精深。
如果说《长春经》是长春宫所有传承的入门总纲，那么他觉得这门《长春养真剑》就是为了配合《长春经》而存在的。
剑舞步移，他浑身慢慢热了起来。
体内真气也在剑招引导之下在经脉中流转起来。
苏白尘心中一动，想起了《长春经》中‘阴阳运化，四时不倾’的口诀。
还有《玄阴气诀》中负阴生阳的奥妙。
他很快就想到了同步引导阴气入体这一步。
下一刻，随着他灵觉的扩散引动阴气，他的周围便充斥了浓郁的阴气。
黑暗中，他又成为了那唯一的闪亮的光点。
而此时他发现自己真气随着剑招运转，竟然可以更高效地炼化阴气！
他不由得剑招渐快，而搅动的阴气也是更为浓郁。
他体内真气随之越来越纯净、醇厚，而他凝结入骨的阴气同样清澈冷冽。

完美。
此时他心里面只有一个词能形容自己现在的状态。
动静的平衡，阴阳的协调。
令他处于一个完美的修炼状态，他的真气与炼化入骨的玄阴灵气同步增长，甚至有点‘螺旋上天’的感觉。
然而他的畅快只持续了一个时辰，下一刻，他手中握着的树枝忽然发出一声脆响，在手中断裂了开来。
苏白尘有些恍惚地看了眼手中断裂的树枝，随后无奈地摇摇头，没有了继续演练的兴致。
不过就算如此，也算是尽兴了吧。
他拍拍手就转身回去了，今日收获很大，已经可以好好睡觉。
而当他走了之后，这‘通天梯’的井洞空间内再次出现了一个身影……正是枫林子。
他弯腰捡起地上掉落的树枝，却没想到那树枝微微用力，就碎成了齑粉。
枫林子恍然：“这是寻常器物承受不住阴气侵蚀……”
如此一边琢磨着一边也往回走，不知道他在想些什么。
……
此后三天，苏白尘没有再和那三个师兄、师姐一样去烦扰枫林子，而是自己独自修炼。
白天他就在风光明媚的校场修炼，晚上则是在那通天梯的楼梯井中。
对于他来说，这是沉浸在每日都有明显进步的快乐中，每天都充实无比。
但对于那三个亲传弟子，就显得他有些孤僻不识趣了。
怎么说他们也是他的师兄、师姐，正常的交流总要有些的吧？
但苏白尘每天就是独自修炼，就是不和别人沟通。
直到第四天，枫林子着急地对其他人道：“师弟师妹，师父今日要考校我们的课业，现在随我去见师父吧。”

除了苏白尘，其余三人都紧张了起来。
看起来他们都很惧怕这种考校。
唯独苏白尘对此‘无知者无畏’，他都不知道玄阴真人对自己有什么要求……
content_en:
;;
Su Baichen found the school grounds, which was indeed a rare and open place.
Facing the sea, the view is extremely broad, which is incomparable to his cabin in the strait.
It's a pity that the elders' dormitory is also here. If he practices swordsmanship here, he will definitely disturb the elders in the dormitory near the school platform.
Although Feng Linzi said it didn't matter, he wasn't the kind of person who would look for trouble.
So after carefully scanning the surroundings, I simply walked to the staircase!
This huge stairwell is called the ‘Stairway to Heaven’. Although it is surrounded by spiraling stairs, there is still a huge empty well in the middle.
Su Baichen picked up a branch at the bottom of the empty well, which was like a small square, and then practiced the 'Changchun Yangzhen Sword' in a relaxed manner.
The more he practices this swordsmanship, the more profound and profound it becomes.
If the "Eternal Spring Sutra" is the general introduction to all inheritances in the Changchun Palace, then he feels that this "Eternal Spring Yangzhen Sword" exists to coordinate with the "Eternal Spring Sutra".
As the sword dance moved, his whole body slowly became warm.
The true energy in the body also circulates in the meridians under the guidance of the sword moves.
Su Baichen's heart moved, and he remembered the mantra in the "Eternal Spring Sutra" that "yin and yang are transported and transformed, and the four seasons are not tilted".
There is also the mystery of negative yin producing yang in "Xuan Yin Qi Jue".
He quickly thought of the step of guiding Yin Qi into the body simultaneously.
The next moment, as the spread of his spiritual sense triggered the Yin Qi, his surroundings were filled with rich Yin Qi.
In the darkness, he became the only shining point of light.
But at this time, he discovered that his true energy circulated with the sword moves, and he could refine the Yin energy more efficiently!
He couldn't help but move his sword faster and faster, and the churning Yin Qi became more intense.
The true energy in his body became more and more pure and mellow, while the Yin energy condensed into his bones was also clear and cold.
Perfect.
At this time, there was only one word in his heart that could describe his current state.
The balance of movement and stillness, the coordination of yin and yang.
Putting him in a perfect state of cultivation, his true energy and the Xuanyin spiritual energy refined into his bones grew simultaneously, and it even felt like a 'spiral to the sky'.
However, his joy only lasted for an hour. The next moment, the branch he was holding suddenly made a crisp sound and broke in his hand.
Su Baichen glanced at the broken branch in his hand in a daze, then shook his head helplessly, losing interest in continuing the drill.
But even so, it’s still fun.
He clapped his hands and turned around to go back. He had gained a lot today and could already sleep well.
And after he left, a figure appeared again in the shaft space of the 'Ladder to Heaven'...it was Feng Linzi.
He bent down to pick up the fallen branch from the ground, but he didn't expect that the branch broke into powder with a little force.
Feng Linzi suddenly realized: "This is an ordinary artifact that cannot withstand the erosion of Yin Qi..."
While thinking about this, he walked back, wondering what he was thinking.
…
In the next three days, Su Baichen did not bother Feng Linzi like the three senior brothers and sisters, but practiced alone.
During the day, he practiced in the beautiful school grounds, and at night, he practiced in the stairwell leading to the sky.
For him, this is about being immersed in the joy of making significant progress every day, and being extremely fulfilling every day.
But for those three direct disciples, he seemed a little withdrawn and ignorant.
After all, they are also his senior brothers and sisters. There must be some normal communication, right?
But Su Baichen practiced alone every day without communicating with others.
Until the fourth day, Feng Linzi anxiously said to the others: "Junior brother and sister, Master is going to test our homework today. Now come with me to see Master."
Except for Su Baichen, the other three people became nervous.
It seems that they are all afraid of this kind of exam.
Su Baichen was the only one who said, "The ignorant are fearless". He didn't even know that Master Xuanyin was afraid of him.What are the requirements...
